verdict.rationale: First-party docs show AI Gateway works with Vercel's own AI SDK, including ToolLoopAgent code samples and gateway-specific `providerOptions.gateway` controls. Existing OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs and client libraries also work by swapping the base URL, with no rewrites. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a dedicated gateway SDK package and its install steps, evidence of language coverage beyond JS/TS, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK experience.
